name: adaptive-guidelines
description: Reuse durable project lessons and suggest skills from validated recurring workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Reuse lessons and suggest skills from recurring workflows
interface.longDescription: Find relevant lessons before work, capture corrections and wasted effort, assess later reuse, and suggest focused skills from validated recurring procedures. Create skills or revise official guidelines only with approval.
defaultPrompt: Use $adaptive-guidelines to consult relevant saved lessons before starting this work.
Use $adaptive-guidelines capture to save lessons from corrections, agent mistakes, and wasted effort in this work.
Use $adaptive-guidelines status to show current observations and candidates.
